name: Talisman: The Horus Heresy - Isstvan Campaign
summary: The Isstvan Campaign expansion allows you to explore the events of The Horus Heresy around the Isstvan System in more detail and play as the Warlords and Legions that fought there. The expansion adds new Warlords, Dataslates and a new region to explore.
